0022600194.text: The Houston Rockets, the 2nd-place team in the West and 1st in the Southwest, come in at 7-2 after a loss in their last game, while the Phoenix Suns are 2-5, 12th in the West and 4.5 games back in the Pacific, having won their last game. Houston is without Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), and Phoenix is without Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Mark Williams (shoulder surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Rockets won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 119-105 win in Phoenix on April 7, 2026.
